title: Bolsa de PD em Inteligência Artificial
institution: Centro de IA e Gestão Pública (CIA-GP), Universidade de São Paulo (EACH)
about: FAPESP postdoctoral fellowship (one position) at the Center for AI and Public Governance (CIA-GP), USP-EACH, São Paulo, on predicting, optimizing and visualizing regulatory workflows with AI and process mining. Principal investigator: Marcelo Fantinato. Expected start December 2026.
requirements: Experience in data science, process mining and machine learning; Python programming
Application by email to the principal investigator (m.fantinato@usp.br), subject "Bolsa PD CIA-GP Edital linha 2", PDF documents
Documents: CV in FAPESP format, updated Lattes CV, master's and doctoral transcripts, motivation letter up to 1,500 words

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling I
why: "Experience in data science, process mining and machine learning" → "Build supervised learning models for regression and classification using methods such as support vector machines, random forests, and gradient boosting."

"predicting, optimizing and visualizing regulatory workflows" → "Understand how deep learning architectures such as CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers can be applied to tabular and time-series analytics problems."
"Machine learning" (skill) → "Compare predictive approaches according to the structure of the data, the analytical objective, and the assumptions of the modelling method."
